coverage_note: October 1, 2026 saved-source snapshot: added exactly 24 audited employers and 184 postings (182 audited rows plus two approved Google additions). Preserved 109 existing businesses and 1,093 jobs without refreshing them. New employer collections cover the audited analytical/business-career scope: Canada-only, English or substantive bilingual advertisements, excluding known publication ages over 180 days. AppDirect geographic advertisements sharing a requisition are consolidated with original variant text retained. Availability and observed source-board changes were checked before release; this is a dated snapshot, not a continuously refreshed feed or a certification of applicant qualifications. The separate 100-employer expansion target is not completed by this release. First-insertion date schema migration: the 24 audited employers and 184 jobs added on October 1, 2026 have date_added_to_dataset 2026-10-01 (America/Toronto). The 109 older businesses and 1,093 older jobs have unknown dates, stored as blank. This migration is not a posting refresh; source capture timestamps and archived evidence are unchanged. Additional user-supplied batch: twenty businesses added with newly collected qualifying postings. All original 133 businesses and 1,277 job records remain unchanged; their historical capture timestamps and availability have not been refreshed. Employer-specific coverage entries document current collection limits and zero qualifying results.

selection_rules.advertisement_language: English or bilingual with substantive English description
selection_rules.country_selection: Country must be Canada only; exclude foreign-only and mixed-country advertisements; remote Canadian postings remain eligible.

location_notes: city and country list the advertised job locations, including additional locations, not company headquarters. Multiple values are separated by semicolons. city is blank when only a country or region is specified. See original postings for city-country pairings and regional remote-work restrictions.
job_url_policy: Prefer stable, direct employer-hosted job-detail pages displaying the full posting. Use the recruitment-platform URL when the employer links directly there, has no separate job-detail page, or its page is inaccessible or outdated. Replace a URL only after verifying the exact same posting by stable identifier or an explicit source link, preserving advertisement language and location.
url_review_notes: Two Ubisoft employer detail pages returned not-found responses; ATS links retained. Coveo direct pages were blocked and hosted Greenhouse links redirected to the employer; existing URLs retained with no accessible alternative verified. CGI bot protection limited direct detail verification. This review does not refresh descriptions, publication dates or availability. Coveo follow-up: recovered employer-page headers verified for all 36 retained exact-ID postings; responsibility/qualification sections checked against employer text and matching live ATS bodies where recovery omitted bullets; 3 linked generic careers pages removed. Direct HTTP may still return empty 202 responses; no empty/blocked page was treated as generic. Coveo generic-page recheck 2026-09-18: Staff Product Designer removed after fresh original-URL recovery showed Open Positions @ Coveo; 35 other exact-ID recovered detail pages corroborated by current ATS availability. Direct HTTP returned empty 202 for all 36 links; no blocked response or ATS status alone caused removal. Dialogue review 2026-09-18: all 30 original URLs freshly checked via HTTP; 28 detail pages and two verified generic-board redirects (Product Data Analyst and Career Counselor). Hopper review 2026-09-18: all 10 exact original URLs checked via fresh HTTP appData and browser; two accounting pages confirmed Job not found and removed.
baseline_coverage_note: Canada-only selection: 260 postings across 9 companies. CGI is excluded at the user's request. Foreign-only and mixed-country postings are excluded; remote Canadian postings remain included. This is a location filter, not a guarantee of individual work authorization.
